completion:

3. Decide what information to include in the failed tests results section.
4. Evaluate electrical safety check software options.
5. Finalize and implement the template.

## Start with the test records

The test records used for recording the first electrical appliance safety check must also be used for recording electrical appliance safety tests after a repair.

The first EIC states are used as the baseline for evaluating subsequent EIC. A comparison of the two EIC s will indicate the progress of the maintenance works. If a different EIC will be used, there will be no point of reference for evaluating the changes. It may be crucial to determine if repairs have affected the safety of the EIC or even have taken it to a better state of safety.

## Add a section for failed electrical tests

The electrical appliance safety checks results must contain a section for indicating the outcome of the electrical appliance safety checks. Any
